tolerances.note: Proposed comparison tolerances for user-GPU GPU_test. They are not measurements from a GPU run in this authoring environment (no CUDA here). Tighten or loosen only with recorded evidence. BFGS full-trajectory bitwise agreement (uncapped) is not required; the capped (maxiter=3 and maxiter=1) driver comparison below is a PASS criterion.
tolerances.spsa_full_rerun_best_E: report-only; may drift if GPU energies differ at 1e-14; not a PASS requirement
tolerances.bfgs_full_rerun: Uncapped 16-start trajectory identity is not a PASS requirement; SciPy line search can diverge after ULP energy differences. The capped BFGS driver check is a PASS requirement.
tolerances.one_optimizer_step: maxiter=1 BFGS vs the CPU oracle: E and g finite, dE / dx / dgrad within bfgs_capped_* tolerances, nit/nfev equal or fail as line-search divergence.

spsa_ledger_energy_abs.note: First K query-log energies (plus and minus separately) vs the CPU oracle SPSA run. Full-trajectory best_E remains report-only.

note: Executed on a CUDA device. A PASS is necessary for production but does not prove bitwise identity with the CPU campaign, nor any speedup. AST/static checks cannot prove CUDA correctness.
